info.name: VAST API Swagger Schema activedirectory capacity API
Query a Tenant for Capacity Details

params.name: path
params.description: Specifies a path. The query response includes details of the specified path and its direct child paths. By default, this is the root path.

params.name: type
params.description: Selects which capacity type is returned as sort_key in the response. Default: usable.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Specifies for which tenant to return a response. By default, this is the default tenant.

items.docs: This endpoint queries a tenant for capacity details for a path on the tenant and its direct child paths.
